risk_factors.heading: We will need to maintain public credibility and confidence in our long-term business prospects in order to succeed.
risk_factors.quote: Any such negative perceptions, whether caused by us or not, may harm our brand and our business (including sales) and make it more difficult to raise additional funds if needed.

risk_factors.heading: We may be unable to effectively grow, or manage the compliance, residual value, financing and credit risks related to, our various financing programs.
risk_factors.quote: The profitability of any directly-leased vehicles returned to us at the end of their leases depends on our ability to accurately project our vehicles’ residual values at the outset of the leases

risk_factors.heading: If we are unable to attract, hire and retain key employees and qualified personnel, our ability to compete may be harmed.
risk_factors.quote: Our future success also depends upon our ability to attract, hire and retain a large number of engineering, manufacturing, marketing, sales and delivery, service, installation, technology and support personnel

risk_factors.heading: We are highly dependent on the services of Elon Musk, Technoking of Tesla and our Chief Executive Officer.
risk_factors.quote: Although Mr. Musk spends significant time with Tesla and is highly active in our management, he does not devote his full time and attention to Tesla.
